Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of ambiguous task scope due to incomplete disambiguation between similar entities/contexts. The Planner incorrectly assumed that the English title "Gently My Songs Entreat" referred to the British film "Unfinished Symphony" (1934) directed by Anthony Asquith, rather than the primary 1933 Austrian-German film "Leise flehen meine Lieder" directed by Willi Forst. This error occurred in the first step of the conversation when the Planner analyzed the initial WebSurfer results and updated its understanding, failing to recognize that the film with the English title "Gently My Songs Entreat" is the same film as "Leise flehen meine Lieder" (1933), not a separate British production. Consequently, the entire subsequent search process focused on the wrong director (Anthony Asquith) instead of the correct one (Willi Forst).
